title: 第472章 不尽兴第471章 求战
slug: 签到大帝修为开局收下禁忌剑体
content_zh:
狂野且充满无穷战意的声音炸响苍穹，震动天地！
申屠狂立在高空，如一座矗立的山峰，浓浓的窒息感铺天盖地！
但凌川却神色不变，仿佛没有感受到这股滔天的气息。
“见面就求战？”
他内心微微一愣，显然有些意外。
这位名叫申屠狂的生灵还真是直截了当，快言快语。
当然实力才是一切的根本，只要足够强大，就无需拐弯抹角，无需在意任何人的看法。
他也看得出来，这申屠狂的确很强，到目前为止，这是他见过的最强之人。
“凌川，你意如何？”
申屠狂神色愈发兴奋，别看他只是泄露了一缕气息，可这一缕气息足以让普通的逍遥境八重天战栗！
然而，凌川却是始终端坐在山巅，岿然不动。
这才有意思，一个强劲的对手让他十分欢喜！
特别是，凌川有极大可能是传说中的.......不灭圣体！
“当年我与申屠苍平分秋色，不知当年的你和他相比，孰强孰弱？”
凌川缓缓起身，直视申屠狂，目光如炬！
同时，一股难以言喻的气势开始升腾，宛若神魔复苏！
“哈哈哈......哈哈哈......”
见状，申屠狂仿佛知道了凌川的选择，他放声大笑，一头浓密的黑发随意披散，笑声狂野不羁，在虚空激荡，搅得无数云层破碎！
他的气势也愈发厚重，宛若神山，压倒天下！
“申屠苍是我族弟，天赋不弱，实力也不错，傲视无数天骄，在我申屠古族年轻弟子中可以排到前五......”

忽然，申屠狂看向凌川，缓缓道来，述说着申屠苍的信息。
然后，就在下一刻，他却话音一转，双眸爆发自信的光束，傲然道：
“他在我面前，撑不过百招！”
轰隆！
申屠狂不再遮掩，恐怖而狂野的气息彻底爆发，席卷八荒六合。
高大魁梧的肉身晶莹无比，表面覆盖着一层淡淡的金色光辉，有着可怕的气息流转，弥漫出一股难以估量的恐怖波动！
这是在肉身一道有着巨大成就的特殊表现！
“既然如此，那就战一场！”
凌川声音高昂，浑身激荡出无穷的战意，直冲云霄！
他从山巅一步迈出，与申屠狂隔空相望！
凌川心里明白，看申屠狂这架势，无论他答应不答应，对方或许都会强行纠缠。
而且，他本身也有类似的想法。
对于他而言，战斗是修行路上的永恒旋律之一！
兹啦！
两人目光一在虚空交汇，便碰撞出激烈的火花！
紧接着！
content_en:
The wild and endless fighting voice exploded in the sky and shook the world!
Shentu Kuang stood high in the sky, like a towering mountain, with a strong sense of suffocation overwhelming him!
But Lingchuan's expression remained unchanged, as if he didn't feel this overwhelming aura.
"Ask for a fight when we meet?"
He was slightly startled in his heart, obviously a little surprised.
This creature named Shentu Kuang is really straightforward and speaks quickly.
Of course, strength is the foundation of everything. As long as you are strong enough, you don't need to beat around the bush or care about anyone's opinions.
He could also see that this Shentu Kuang was indeed very strong. So far, he was the strongest person he had ever seen.
"Lingchuan, what do you think?"
Shentu Kuang's expression became more and more excited. Even though he just leaked a breath, this breath was enough to make ordinary people in the eighth level of Xiaoyao Realm tremble!
However, Lingchuan always sat on the top of the mountain, unmoving.
This is interesting, a strong opponent makes him very happy!
In particular, Lingchuan is very likely to be the legendary... Immortal Holy Body!
"Back then, Shen Tucang and I were equally matched. I wonder who was stronger or weaker than you back then?"
Lingchuan stood up slowly and looked directly at Shentu Kuang, his eyes burning like fire!
At the same time, an indescribable momentum began to rise, like a god and demon resurrecting!
"Hahaha...hahaha..."
Seeing this, Shentu Kuang seemed to know Lingchuan's choice. He laughed loudly, his thick black hair hanging freely, his laughter was wild and uninhibited, stirring in the void, causing countless clouds to break!
His aura became more and more powerful, like a sacred mountain, overwhelming the world!
"Shentu Cang is a younger brother of my clan. He is not weak in talent and has good strength. He is proud of countless geniuses. He can be ranked in the top five among the young disciples of my ancient Shentu clan..."
Suddenly, Shentu Kuang looked at Lingchuan and spoke slowly, recounting Shentu Cang's information.
Then, at the next moment, he changed his words, his eyes burst into confident beams, and he said proudly:
"He can't survive a hundred moves in front of me!"
Boom!
Shentu Kuang no longer concealed himself, and the terrifying and wild aura completely erupted, sweeping across all parts of the world.
The tall and burly body was extremely crystal clear, and its surface was covered with a layer of faint golden light. It had a terrifying aura flowing around it, and filled the air with an incalculable terrifying wave!
This is a special manifestation of great achievements in the physical body!
"In that case, let's fight!"
Lingchuan's voice was high, and his whole body was filled with endless fighting spirit, soaring into the sky!
He took one step from the top of the mountain and faced Shentu Kuang across the sky!
Lingchuan knew in his heart that judging from Shentu Kuang's attitude, whether he agreed or not, the other party might forcefully entangle him.
Moreover, he himself had similar thoughts.
For him, fighting is one of the eternal melodies on the path of spiritual practice!
Here it is!
As soon as the two people's eyes met in the void, there were fierce sparks!
Next!
